_notes_drones: Scout drones (docs/missions-contract.md B; game/sim/Surface/Drones.cs). aerial: true = it flies: no lanes, terrain, buildings, water, mountains or dome transits; a straight line at speed tiles a second (terrain move_cost doesn't apply). Made at a Machine Shop (surfaces/fabrication.json recipe scout_drone, the resource of the same id), unpacked by a finished Drone Pad (buildings drone_bays) into each empty bay, launched from there to a tile inside comms coverage (surfaces/comms.json). drone: battery_seconds of flight on a full charge (it drains while the drone is off its bay, launch to landing); reserve = share of the battery it keeps: it turns home when what is left only just covers the way back and the landing plus this reserve, and launches only with at least reserve + 0.1 and enough to get there and back; recharge_seconds from empty to full docked on a working pad; launch_seconds lifting off the bay, land_seconds setting down; loiter_seconds circling its target (surveying) before it flies home; a drone whose battery runs out comes down (Lost) and is gone lost_seconds later. No damage, tyres or repairs; not a Vehicle Bay product. All numbers are placeholders.

units.description: A small quad tilt-rotor scout, built at a Machine Shop from parts and launched from a Drone Pad. It flies straight to the tile you pick, over water, mountains and buildings alike, surveying everything under it (2 tiles round), circles the target for a while and flies home to recharge. It needs comms coverage all the way (a colony core's antenna, or a relay satellite in orbit) and a battery that reaches there and back: it turns home on its own when the battery runs low or it loses the link, and one that runs dry comes down and is lost. Right-click retargets it in flight; RETURN calls it home.
